strategyReview: Live portfolio is heavily concentrated in a single falling GOLD-FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG trade; that signal family is losing money overall. The strongest live signals are ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO (4/4 wins, +4.5% avg PnL) and PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW/HIGH (positive PnL with decent sample). The biggest pocket of expected profit sits in shadow signals — WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG and USER_PM_IV_TOUCH_RICH_NO show consistent, large edge — yet they remain blocked. Several shadow-mined one‑touch and funding‑reversion variants are decaying, largely because they rely on edge magnitude or funding extremes without regime or expiry context. The AMZN perp‑convergence family is critically ill: most tests are unscorable and the few scorable ones repeatedly invalidate the funding‑normalization assumption. Tonight’s focus is on diagnosing the consistent losers, hardening refinements around extremity and time-to-expiry, and piping fresh discoveries from the wallet‑flow and one‑touch NO edge clusters into shadow tests.

failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG live: 36 trades, 44% win, avg PnL -0.50%; HYPE and AMZN assets particularly bad (33% and 29% win). FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT live: only slightly better (+0.0018 total PnL, 59% win) but OIL is a clear loser (38% win, -0.007).
failureClusters.recommendation: Tighten funding entry thresholds (e.g. require extreme percentile) or add a confirming flow/P/C condition before letting these signals fire.

failureClusters.evidence: Scorable hypothesis tests only 42% win; 83 tests unscorable. Primary condition (basis > -0.05, funding > 0) does not lead to perp underperformance — funding stays pinned at 5.5% and basis does not widen.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re‑author the convergence hypothesis to require funding decline already underway (funding_change_pct_24h < 0) and keep basis near zero, so that the arb is demonstrably compressing rather than assumed.

failureClusters.theme: Gold One‑Touch Heatmap Edge Not Predictive
failureClusters.evidence: All 17 shadow tests of H-534 lost; gold spot barely moved during the 2‑day window despite large underlying‑cap edge (≥10 pts).
failureClusters.recommendation: Integrate an expiry filter (days_to_expiry ≤ 30) and moderate edge band (3‑8 pts) based on FIND-0036; kill the raw ≥10 pt edge version.

failureClusters.evidence: Every scorable test in the cross‑asset IV compression / vol expansion family failed — BTC consistently lost ~1.6% vs the long prediction, while HYPE risk‑on conditions were met.
failureClusters.recommendation: The signal appears to mark trend exhaustion rather than continuation; either invert direction or require a pull‑back before entry. Without a new mechanism, leave the family disabled.

newHypotheses.description: Smart‑money fade: when tracked smart wallets are net short YES (smart_flow_stance ≤ -1) on above‑strike one‑touch contracts, the smart flow expects spot weakness. Tests the dip‑YES smart / high‑YES dumb asymmetry from FIND-0020.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot will decline >2% within 7 days as smart money’s bearish flow on upside touch resolves favorably.

newHypotheses.description: Broad one‑touch NO edge with moderate mispricing: for any asset with upside touch contracts, enter short (sell YES) when the sell‑YES edge is between 3 and 8 probability points, per FIND-0030 cluster.
newHypotheses.prediction: The mispricing will compress as the contract approaches expiry, leading to spot decline >2% within 7 days.

newHypotheses.description: Rich PM IV NO fade: when Polymarket implied volatility exceeds listed‑option IV by ≥10 vol points on upside touch contracts, sell YES to fade the fear premium, per FIND-0021 cluster.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot will decline >2% within 7 days as the IV premium compresses and the NO side regains value.

newHypotheses.description: BTC‑only one‑touch NO edge with moderate strength: sell YES on BTC upside touch contracts when edge between 3‑8 pts, per FIND-0043’s 76% win cluster.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot will decline >2% within 7 days as the edge compresses toward expiry.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H‑005: require AMZN funding rate to have already started declining (24h change < 0) while basis remains near zero. This ensures the convergence process is underway, not merely assumed.
newHypotheses.prediction: AMZN stock will outperform the perp by >2% within 7 days as funding continues to decline and the perp‑spot basis normalizes.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H‑534: narrow the gold one‑touch edge to moderate levels (3‑8 pts) and require expiry within 30 days, per FIND-0036’s 75% win cluster on near‑expiry gold NO contracts.
newHypotheses.prediction: GOLD spot will decline >2% within 7 days as the moderate edge compresses before expiry.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H‑539: capture only extreme CBRS funding overshoots — bottom 5th percentile of the last 7 days and below -20% — with evidence of reversal (positive 24h change). Avoids mid‑range noise.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS spot will bounce >2% within 2 days as the extreme overshoot normalizes.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H‑537: apply the same extreme‑overshoot logic to AAPL — bottom 5th percentile funding and below -20% with a positive 24h change to confirm reversal.
newHypotheses.prediction: AAPL spot will bounce >2% within 2 days as the extreme overshoot resolves.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H‑001: convert the IV‑expansion thesis to a bearish directional play — only activate when BTC is already near its 7‑day high, indicating the compression precedes a reversal down rather than a random jump.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC will decline >2% within 3 days as the IV compression unwinds in a pullback from the recent high.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The thesis predicted that positive AMZN funding with near‑zero basis would trigger perp underperformance and stock outperformance. In practice funding hovered near 5.5% without declining, basis stayed flat, and the convergence never materialised. Six recent tests all ended without meaningful funding normalization.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Positive AMZN funding with near‑zero basis reliably normalizes and causes perp‑spot convergence.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Despite a persistent underlying‑cap edge ≥10 pts on gold one‑touch NO contracts, gold spot neither declined 2% nor showed any directional pressure. The edge remained high for days, indicating it reflects a structural premium rather than an imminent market move.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying‑cap edge on gold one‑touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: CBRS funding below -10% often reverted sharply, producing winning trades, but the primary variant also suffered many losses when funding became even more negative or oscillated wildly, preventing a clean spot bounce. The assumption that any deeply negative funding quickly normalizes is not robust.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Deeply negative CBRS funding reliably reverts and leads to a >2% spot gain within 2 days without additional extremity or reversal confirmation.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL funding below -10% showed similar unreliability — about half the tests failed to normalize within the timeframe, and spot gains did not follow. The pattern suggests that extreme but not oversold funding levels are insufficient triggers.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Extreme negative AAPL funding rapidly normalizes and leads to a spot gain without requiring a true tail‑event overshoot.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The early wins coincided with a downtrend where IV compression preceded large downward moves. Later tests, under ranging or mildly bearish conditions, consistently missed the 2% absolute‑move target. The hypothesis does not account for market regime — it assumes any compression yields a big move.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC PM IV below 46 while options IV remains high guarantees a >2% absolute spot move within 3 days regardless of trend context.

hypothesisReviews.observation: All eight scorable tests across the cross‑asset IV‑compression family failed, with BTC declining ~1.6% each time. The HYPE risk‑on confirmation signaled momentum that was already exhausted, turning the thesis into a fade rather than a continuation.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC above short‑term trend with HYPE spot above SMA and OI stable confirms a >2% BTC long move over 3‑7 days.

journalEntry: Tonight’s review identified clear winners (one‑touch NO edge live, weekend funding reversion shadow) and chronic losers (gold heatmap edge, cross‑asset BTC continuation, AMZN convergence). Learned invalid assumptions have been formally recorded for six struggling families, preventing future recycled theses. New hypotheses are strictly catalog‑aligned: four from ranked FINDs (wallet flow asymmetry, one‑touch edge clusters, rich PM IV NO) and five targeted refinements that attack diagnosed failure mechanisms — requiring funding already declining, adding near‑expiry and moderate edge bands, capturing extreme overshoots with reversal confirmation, and conditioning BTC IV expansion on a near‑high reversal context. No parameter changes were warranted tonight; the existing signal‑risk stops are adequately sized.
